purpose: Registers app theme T03 in the existing central music player while preserving the v0.6.15 house navigation and artwork.

checks.theme: T03 is a separate app-theme manifest record at /media/audio/THEME.mp3; not assigned to any card or K01–K06 soundscape.
checks.audio: One shared audio session; selection does not play; explicit Start is required; loop and autoplay are disabled.
checks.navigation: T03 selects individual mode so card and room navigation does not replace or restart it.
checks.packaging: App archive contains only home/; shared audio remains outside the application package.

limitations: THEME.mp3 was not present locally; media availability and real playback require separate upload and testing.
No iPhone Safari, VoiceOver, or visual browser test performed.
